output.reason: The segment data is strong (5.2 TV sessions stall at 5.9% while everything else on Tessaline is at about 0.6%), but the brief never explains why 5.2 is fine in the ten other markets that also have it, and it talks about "pausing the wider rollout" even though the release is already live everywhere. The most likely answer is an interaction between 5.2 and Tessaline, and that makes its flat dismissal of the CDN unconvincing.
